name: Incipience
author: saustin2010
summary: Eleven-instrument drum synth laid out like the Jomox AlphaBase Mk II (kick, MBrane, hats, clap, rim, cymbals, two sample players, a four-operator FM synth, reverb and delay), with RANDOMISE on each instrument, a mod matrix and MIDI lanes; each instrument chromatic on its own MIDI channel, and on its own track with Incipience OUT; plays the AlphaBase's free sample set and your own WAV files from the MPC's drives.
